liv_record_cabinet.name: Record cabinet
liv_record_cabinet.flavor: Alphabetised once, in 1987, and never since.

liv_telephone_seat.name: Telephone seat
liv_telephone_seat.flavor: Built for long calls to an aunt. Still smells faintly of them.

liv_hall_bench.name: Hall bench, lift-top
liv_hall_bench.flavor: Open it and you will find every glove, but never two that match.

liv_jukebox.name: Jukebox
liv_jukebox.flavor: Plays B-sides only. Someone fiddled with it.

liv_arcade_cabinet.name: Arcade cabinet
liv_arcade_cabinet.flavor: The high score is from a previous owner and has not been beaten.

liv_chaise_longue.name: Chaise longue
liv_chaise_longue.flavor: For fainting on, or for the cat, which is the same thing.

liv_nest_of_tables.name: Nest of tables
liv_nest_of_tables.flavor: Three tables, used one at a time, for forty years.

liv_card_table.name: Card table, folding
liv_card_table.flavor: The baize has a cigarette burn exactly where the trumps go.

liv_writing_bureau.name: Writing bureau
liv_writing_bureau.flavor: The key is lost, so the gas bills are safe in there forever.

liv_longcase_clock.name: Longcase clock
liv_longcase_clock.flavor: Strikes thirteen at midnight. Nobody has the heart to fix it.

liv_pedestal_fan.name: Pedestal fan
liv_pedestal_fan.flavor: Three speeds: breeze, gale, and the papers are off the table.

liv_radiogram.name: Radiogram
liv_radiogram.flavor: Takes a minute to warm up, like most things in the house.

liv_revolving_bookcase.name: Revolving bookcase
liv_revolving_bookcase.flavor: Give it a spin and the book you wanted goes round the back.

liv_plant_stand.name: Plant stand, wrought iron
liv_plant_stand.flavor: Bought for the plants. Now holds the post.

liv_piano_stool.name: Piano stool
liv_piano_stool.flavor: The lid hides grade three sheet music and a fossilised toffee.

liv_cello_case.name: Cello in a hard case
liv_cello_case.flavor: Gets its own seat on the train, and the better one.

liv_dog_basket.name: Dog basket, wicker
liv_dog_basket.flavor: The dog prefers the sofa. The basket is for show.

liv_fireguard.name: Fireguard, mesh
liv_fireguard.flavor: Keeps the sparks in and the toast out.

liv_coal_scuttle.name: Coal scuttle
liv_coal_scuttle.flavor: No coal in it since the Clean Air Act. Kindling and a lighter now.

liv_wood_stove.name: Wood-burning stove
liv_wood_stove.flavor: Heats one armchair to perfection and the rest of the room not at all.

liv_cocktail_cabinet.name: Cocktail cabinet
liv_cocktail_cabinet.flavor: Opens to a mirror, a light and a bottle of advocaat from 1979.

liv_harp.name: Harp
liv_harp.flavor: Forty-seven strings, all slightly out, all the time.

liv_plaster_bust.name: Plaster bust on a plinth
liv_plaster_bust.flavor: Nobody knows who he is. He has seen everything.

liv_egg_chair.name: Hanging egg chair
liv_egg_chair.flavor: Sways gently. Bad news for anyone holding tea.

liv_blanket_ladder.name: Blanket ladder
liv_blanket_ladder.flavor: Not for climbing. It has been tested.

liv_draught_excluder.name: Draught excluder, sausage dog
liv_draught_excluder.flavor: Guards the door. Has never once barked.

liv_terrarium.name: Terrarium
liv_terrarium.flavor: A tiny world that needs watering once a month and never is.

liv_carriage_clock.name: Carriage clock
liv_carriage_clock.flavor: Presented for thirty years of service. It has done ten.

liv_snow_globe.name: Snow globe
liv_snow_globe.flavor: A souvenir of Skegness, where it does not snow.

liv_hourglass.name: Hourglass
liv_hourglass.flavor: Three minutes exactly, for eggs nobody boils any more.

liv_decanter_set.name: Decanter and tumblers
liv_decanter_set.flavor: The sherry has been there since the wedding. Which wedding is unclear.

liv_humidor.name: Cigar humidor
liv_humidor.flavor: Holds two cigars, both left over from a christening.

liv_jigsaw_board.name: Jigsaw in progress
liv_jigsaw_board.flavor: A thousand pieces, nine hundred and ninety-eight present.

liv_hifi_stack.name: Hi-fi separates
liv_hifi_stack.flavor: Every component a different brand, and every one important.

liv_video_recorder.name: Video recorder
liv_video_recorder.flavor: Flashes 12:00 and will until the end of time.

liv_remote_caddy.name: Remote control caddy
liv_remote_caddy.flavor: Four remotes. One of them works the telly.

liv_photo_frames.name: Photo frames, mantelpiece trio
liv_photo_frames.flavor: Weddings, graduations and a dog that has since passed on.

liv_brass_elephant.name: Brass elephant
liv_brass_elephant.flavor: Brought back from somewhere by someone. Very heavy for its size.

liv_china_dogs.name: China dogs, mantelpiece pair
liv_china_dogs.flavor: They face each other and have not spoken in years.

liv_ice_bucket.name: Ice bucket and tongs
liv_ice_bucket.flavor: Comes out at Christmas. The ice comes out of a bag.

liv_soda_siphon.name: Soda siphon
liv_soda_siphon.flavor: Squirts sideways if you press it with any conviction.

liv_cocktail_shaker.name: Cocktail shaker set
liv_cocktail_shaker.flavor: Shaken once, for a party in 1983. Still slightly sticky.

liv_bookends.name: Bookends with books
liv_bookends.flavor: Six books held firmly in place, unread, with great dignity.

liv_glass_cloche.name: Glass cloche with stuffed bird
liv_glass_cloche.flavor: A robin, under glass, judging you since 1911.

liv_hamster_cage.name: Hamster cage
liv_hamster_cage.flavor: The hamster sleeps all day and runs a marathon at three in the morning.

liv_dinner_gong.name: Dinner gong
liv_dinner_gong.flavor: Struck once a year, for the turkey. The dog leaves the room.

liv_barometer.name: Banjo barometer
liv_barometer.flavor: Has pointed at Change since anyone can remember.

liv_macrame_hanger.name: Macramé plant hanger
liv_macrame_hanger.flavor: Knotted at an evening class, along with a lot of opinions.

liv_plate_rack.name: Display plates on a rack
liv_plate_rack.flavor: Royal occasions, commemorated in blue and white, never eaten off.

liv_cuckoo_clock.name: Cuckoo clock
liv_cuckoo_clock.flavor: The bird comes out on the hour and looks disappointed.

liv_letter_rack.name: Wall letter rack
liv_letter_rack.flavor: Bills at the back, postcards at the front, wisdom nowhere.

liv_butterfly_case.name: Butterfly display case
liv_butterfly_case.flavor: Pinned by a great-uncle who also collected grudges.

liv_wall_sconce.name: Wall sconce
liv_wall_sconce.flavor: Sheds a warm light on the picture hook it replaced.

liv_flying_ducks.name: Flying ducks, set of three
liv_flying_ducks.flavor: Heading for the coving and taking their time about it.

liv_medal_frame.name: Framed medals
liv_medal_frame.flavor: Never discussed at dinner. Polished every November.

liv_door_chime.name: Door chime
liv_door_chime.flavor: Ding dong, then the long wait while someone finds their slippers.

liv_wreath.name: Door wreath
liv_wreath.flavor: Up in December, down in March, after a reminder.
